text:
yara: Quick debrief from today's onboarding run. Recurring pain: SDKs expose different error shapes and teams are unsure what to do on 401/429. Leads to duplicated mapping code in sample apps.
omar: Saw a 7% drop in the signup funnel when the client just showed "Unauthorized" with no next step. We need an actionable surface, not freeform messages.
elie: Proposal: standardize on a tiny, flat error contract across SDKs. Fields: error_type, status, code, message, retryable, retry_after_ms (nullable), resolution, short_hint, metadata. Keep it easy to map in each language.
tina: I like `resolution` as the machine action label (values: reauth, backoff, reduce_rate, contact_support, none). Frontend maps resolution->CTA. `short_hint` is a human-friendly one-liner.
yara: Server infra note: Retry-After incoming formats are messy (seconds | HTTP-date). We'll surface an explicit header `X-RI-Retry-Ms` for critical endpoints to avoid parsing ambiguity; clients should still accept standard Retry-After.
omar: Streaming edge-case: some streams return 200 frames with embedded error JSON {"error":{"code":"quota_exceeded"}}. SDKs must detect and raise the same typed error rather than returning partial text.
elie: Minimal mapping draft: 400 -> BadRequest (resolution:none), 401 -> AuthError (code invalid_token|revoked -> resolution:reauth|contact_support), 403 -> PermissionError (contact_support), 404 -> NotFound (none), 408/429/503 -> ThrottleError (backoff, include retry_after_ms when present), 5xx -> ServerError (backoff for 502/503/504).
tina: Example JS consumer-facing throw we can document:

throw new ThrottleError({
  message: 'rate limit exceeded',
  status: 429,
  code: 'rate_limit',
  retryable: true,
  retry_after_ms: 30000,
  resolution: 'backoff',
  short_hint: 'wait and retry or reduce request rate'
});

omar: For OAuth errors: if response body includes error_description or error="invalid_token" map to invalid_token and resolution=reauth. If we see reason:revoked then resolution=contact_support and retryable=false.
yara: Test plan: cross-SDK harness with these vectors: Retry-After seconds, Retry-After HTTP-date, X-RI-Retry-Ms present, body-embedded error, streaming-frame error, oauth invalid_token, oauth revoked_user. Add acceptance tests to sample-app so UI mapping is exercised.
elie: Rollout plan: compatibility shim in SDKs mapping previous shapes to the new contract for one release, bump minor semver, canary in staging, then flip default. Docs change + sample-app update in the same PR showing before/after metrics.
ci-bot: CI: queued cross-lang parser tests.
docs-bot: Created issue: "Error ergonomics: unified contract + resolution hints" assigned to @elie, due in 1 week.
tina: Small ask: include a small machine `code` enum in logs so infra and SLOs can filter reliably.
yara: I'll open the RFC with the exact field list, enum set, and starter snippets for JS/Go/Py. Please drop test vectors and sample-app metrics in the PR. Thanks all!
